<script>
// modal video embed auto-play and auto-shut-up
// Read src/type from Bootstrap's event.relatedTarget so we never stash across
// handlers (survives button re-renders from A/B, GTM, etc.).
jQuery(document).ready(function() {
  function getEmbedTrigger(event) {
    var related = event.relatedTarget;
    if (!related) {
      return jQuery();
    }
    var $related = jQuery(related);
    if ($related.is('[data-toggle="modal"][data-type]')) {
      return $related;
    }
    return $related.closest('[data-toggle="modal"][data-type]');
  }

  // Demo only: show loader as soon as the modal starts opening
  jQuery('#modalEmbedDemo').on('show.bs.modal', function(event) {
    var $trigger = getEmbedTrigger(event);
    if ($trigger.data('type') !== 'demo' || !$trigger.data('src')) {
      return;
    }

    jQuery(this).find('.modal-body').html(
      '<div class="demo-embed-wrap">' +
        '<div class="demo-embed-loading" aria-live="polite" aria-busy="true">' +
          '<span class="demo-embed-spinner" role="status" aria-label="Loading demo"></span>' +
          '<div class="demo-embed-error">' +
            'Unable to load the demo. ' +
            '<a href="' + $trigger.data('src') + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Open it in a new tab</a>.' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>'
    );
  });

  // Demo only: inject Guideflow after modal is fully shown/sized
  jQuery('#modalEmbedDemo').on('shown.bs.modal', function(event) {
    var modal = jQuery(this);
    var $trigger = getEmbedTrigger(event);
    var src = $trigger.data('src');
    var $wrap = modal.find('.demo-embed-wrap');
    var $loading = modal.find('.demo-embed-loading');
    var revealed = false;
    var loadTimedOut = false;

    if ($trigger.data('type') !== 'demo' || !src || !$wrap.length) {
      return;
    }

    var $iframe = jQuery(
      '<iframe width="100%" height="100%" scrolling="no" allow="clipboard-read; clipboard-write" ' +
      'webkitallowfullscreen mozallowfullscreen allowfullscreen allowtransparency="true"></iframe>'
    );

    function revealDemo() {
      if (revealed || loadTimedOut) {
        return;
      }
      revealed = true;
      $loading.addClass('is-done').attr('aria-busy', 'false');
      $iframe.addClass('is-ready');
    }

    function showDemoError() {
      if (revealed) {
        return;
      }
      loadTimedOut = true;
      $loading.addClass('is-error').attr('aria-busy', 'false');
    }

    $iframe.on('load', revealDemo);
    $wrap.append($iframe);
    $iframe.attr('src', src);

    // If Guideflow never loads, show an error + direct link instead of a blank iframe
    window.setTimeout(showDemoError, 8000);
  });

  // Other embed modals: same relatedTarget pattern, no visual changes
  jQuery('#modalEmbed, #modalEmbedDarkMode').on('shown.bs.modal', function(event) {
    var modal = jQuery(this);
    var $trigger = getEmbedTrigger(event);
    var src = $trigger.data('src');
    var type = $trigger.data('type');
    var modalBody = modal.find('.modal-body');
    var iframe;

    if (!src || !type) {
      return;
    }

    if (type === 'pardot' || type === 'embed') {
      iframe = modalBody.html('<iframe width="100%" height="450" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>').children('iframe');

      if (type === 'pardot') {
        iframe.on('load', function() {
          iFrameResize();
        });
        iframe.attr('src', src);
      }
      if (type === 'embed') {
        iframe.attr('src', src + '?autoplay=1&enablejsapi=1&rel=0');
        ytTracker.init();
      }
    }
  });

  jQuery('.modal-in-footer').on('hidden.bs.modal', function() {
    jQuery(this).find('.modal-body').html('');
  });
});
</script>

<script>
// modal video embed auto-play and auto-shut-up
// Read src/type from Bootstrap's event.relatedTarget so we never stash across
// handlers (survives button re-renders from A/B, GTM, etc.).
jQuery(document).ready(function() {
  function getEmbedTrigger(event) {
    var related = event.relatedTarget;
    if (!related) {
      return jQuery();
    }
    var $related = jQuery(related);
    if ($related.is('[data-toggle="modal"][data-type]')) {
      return $related;
    }
    return $related.closest('[data-toggle="modal"][data-type]');
  }

  // Demo only: show loader as soon as the modal starts opening
  jQuery('#modalEmbedDemo').on('show.bs.modal', function(event) {
    var $trigger = getEmbedTrigger(event);
    if ($trigger.data('type') !== 'demo' || !$trigger.data('src')) {
      return;
    }

    jQuery(this).find('.modal-body').html(
      '<div class="demo-embed-wrap">' +
        '<div class="demo-embed-loading" aria-live="polite" aria-busy="true">' +
          '<span class="demo-embed-spinner" role="status" aria-label="Loading demo"></span>' +
          '<div class="demo-embed-error">' +
            'Unable to load the demo. ' +
            '<a href="' + $trigger.data('src') + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Open it in a new tab</a>.' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>'
    );
  });

  // Demo only: inject Guideflow after modal is fully shown/sized
  jQuery('#modalEmbedDemo').on('shown.bs.modal', function(event) {
    var modal = jQuery(this);
    var $trigger = getEmbedTrigger(event);
    var src = $trigger.data('src');
    var $wrap = modal.find('.demo-embed-wrap');
    var $loading = modal.find('.demo-embed-loading');
    var revealed = false;
    var loadTimedOut = false;

    if ($trigger.data('type') !== 'demo' || !src || !$wrap.length) {
      return;
    }

    var $iframe = jQuery(
      '<iframe width="100%" height="100%" scrolling="no" allow="clipboard-read; clipboard-write" ' +
      'webkitallowfullscreen mozallowfullscreen allowfullscreen allowtransparency="true"></iframe>'
    );

    function revealDemo() {
      if (revealed || loadTimedOut) {
        return;
      }
      revealed = true;
      $loading.addClass('is-done').attr('aria-busy', 'false');
      $iframe.addClass('is-ready');
    }

    function showDemoError() {
      if (revealed) {
        return;
      }
      loadTimedOut = true;
      $loading.addClass('is-error').attr('aria-busy', 'false');
    }

    $iframe.on('load', revealDemo);
    $wrap.append($iframe);
    $iframe.attr('src', src);

    // If Guideflow never loads, show an error + direct link instead of a blank iframe
    window.setTimeout(showDemoError, 8000);
  });

  // Other embed modals: same relatedTarget pattern, no visual changes
  jQuery('#modalEmbed, #modalEmbedDarkMode').on('shown.bs.modal', function(event) {
    var modal = jQuery(this);
    var $trigger = getEmbedTrigger(event);
    var src = $trigger.data('src');
    var type = $trigger.data('type');
    var modalBody = modal.find('.modal-body');
    var iframe;

    if (!src || !type) {
      return;
    }

    if (type === 'pardot' || type === 'embed') {
      iframe = modalBody.html('<iframe width="100%" height="450" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>').children('iframe');

      if (type === 'pardot') {
        iframe.on('load', function() {
          iFrameResize();
        });
        iframe.attr('src', src);
      }
      if (type === 'embed') {
        iframe.attr('src', src + '?autoplay=1&enablejsapi=1&rel=0');
        ytTracker.init();
      }
    }
  });

  jQuery('.modal-in-footer').on('hidden.bs.modal', function() {
    jQuery(this).find('.modal-body').html('');
  });
});
</script>

      if (revealed || loadTimedOut) {
